limits: This independent reviewer performed no paid synthesis, listening, animation rendering, production access, media approval or upload. The separate guarded backend synchronization is documented in backend-verification.json.
Synthetic tests prove byte binding and control flow only; they do not prove pronunciation, acting quality, timing or final mix quality.
Localization still needs its own language cast, separately timed CC and speech-free music/effects production and acceptance.

findings: Every verification still reads the entire current file and computes its full SHA-256; a mismatch returns that digest for immediate rejection before decoding or cache reuse.
Only an exact immutable SHA-256 key can reuse previously validated format/sample count. The bounded map stores at most 1024 numeric counts, not WAV bytes, file paths or timestamps.

The expected timeline sample count is compared on every matching-hash check, including cache hits. Explicit binding uses map((file) => measured(file)) so the array index cannot become the verification flag.
The review fixture now writes current narration provenance with ok:false, preserving negative quality-check behavior rather than inventing a passing assembly.
The duration QA fixture writes deterministic bound WAVs and attaches the narration SHA. Its body/presentation duration boundary assertions are unchanged.

independent_test.coverage: The cache is warmed by initial binding/approval before same-duration per-line and narration byte changes. Both invalidate approval; missing bindings and mismatched transcript hashes still reject.
